title: DNA-binding factor footprints and enhancer RNAs identify functional non-coding genetic variants
authors: Simon C Biddie; Giovanna Weykopf; Elizabeth F. Hird; Elias T. Friman; Wendy A Bickmore
one_liner_zh: 该文利用DNase足迹和增强子RNA等调控标记识别功能性非编码变异，虽涉及DNA结合因子占位但未聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的功能基因组学应用，对本课题启发有限。
abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have revealed a multitude of candidate genetic variants affecting the risk of developing complex traits and diseases. However, these highlighted regions are typically in the non-coding genome, and uncovering the functional causative single nucleotide variants (SNVs) is challenging. Prioritisation of variants is commonly based on functional genomic annotation with markers of active regulatory elements, but current approaches still poorly predict functional variants. To address this, we systematically analyse six markers of active regulatory elements for their ability to identify functional variants. We benchmark against molecular quantitative trait loci (molQTL) from assays of regulatory element activity that identify allelic effects on DNA-binding factor occupancy, reporter assay expression, and chromatin accessibility. We identify the combination of DNase footprints and divergent enhancer RNA as markers for functional variants. This signature provides high precision, trading-off low recall, thus substantially reducing candidate variant sets to prioritise variants for functional validation. We present this as a framework called FINDER – Functional SNV IdeNtification using DNase footprints and Enhancer RNA, and demonstrate its utility to prioritise variants using leukocyte count trait and analyse variants in linkage disequilibrium with a lead variant to predict a functional variant in asthma. Our findings have implications for prioritising variants from GWAS, in development of predictive scoring algorithms, and for functionally informed fine mapping approaches.
abstract_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已揭示大量影响复杂性状和疾病风险发生的候选遗传变异。然而，这些显著区域通常位于非编码基因组中，识别功能性致病变异（SNVs）颇具挑战。变异优先级排序通常基于功能基因组注释，并辅以活性调控元件的标记，但现有方法对功能性变异的预测能力仍显不足。为解决此问题，我们系统分析了六种活性调控元件标记，评估其识别功能性变异的能力。我们以分子数量性状位点（molQTL）为基准，这些位点来自调控元件活性检测，可识别DNA结合因子占据、报告基因表达及染色质可及性上的等位基因效应。我们发现DNase足迹与发散性增强子RNA的组合可作为功能性变异的标记。该特征提供高精度，但以低召回率为代价，从而显著缩减候选变异集，以优先选择用于功能验证的变异。我们将其作为名为FINDER（利用DNase足迹和增强子RNA进行功能性SNV识别）的框架提出，并展示其利用白细胞计数性状优先排序变异及分析与先导变异连锁不平衡中的变异以预测哮喘功能性变异的实用性。我们的发现对从GWAS中优先选择变异、开发预测评分算法及功能信息精细定位方法具有重要意义。
